name: serine/threonine kinase 11

function.text: STK11 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase STK11. Annotated molecular activities include protein serine kinase activity and protein serine/threonine kinase activity. It participates in activation of protein kinase activity and signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Peutz-Jeghers syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Lung adenocarcinoma; STK11 adnexal tumor; Adenocarcinoma of cervix. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
